current_status.text: The strict nightly GB200 runtime gate passed in OCI-HSG job 5891865 with non-empty capture and replay on all four GPUs.

The first five 20-step jobs failed at their first HybridEP dispatch because the launcher forced a 16-rank NVLink domain for an 8-rank expert group; this was a common topology error, not a scope-specific CUDA Graph failure.
Corrected jobs 5893771, 5893773, 5893775, 5893777, and 5893778 completed 20/20 steps with EP=8, NVLink-domain ranks=8, sequence packing, warmup=3, checkpoints disabled, and no runtime errors.
Steps 11-19 report 100% eligible-call coverage and zero fallbacks for every CG arm, but one cache miss and graph capture per optimizer step with zero cache hits.

Provisional E2E TPS deltas versus baseline are mamba +1.0%, attn -6.0%, router -6.3%, router-plus-preprocess -2.1%, attn-plus-mamba-plus-router -16.9%, and the four-way scope -13.0%; policy-training TPS regresses 33-56% across CG arms.

Correctness is not cleared: router-only reaches token_mult_prob_error=6751 and policy_kl_error=6750 at step 16, attn has a smaller step-18 spike, and explicit router/expert/update parity is not logged.

Combination jobs 5894286 and 5894434 completed 20/20 steps with no runtime errors. The three-way arm has token_mult_prob_error max 1.059 and policy_kl_error max 0.0247 over steps 11-19; the four-way arm reaches 1.312 and 0.273 respectively, so neither is correctness-cleared without explicit parity.

changes.text: Forward HybridEP topology through the canonical NeMo-RL megatron_cfg path instead of overriding DeepEP environment variables directly.
Reject incompatible expert-parallel and NVLink-domain sizes before sbatch; Nano EP=8 with domain=16 now fails fast.
Keep baseline, mamba, attn, router, and router-plus-preprocess in separate persistent checkouts and W&B runs.

next_steps.text: Isolate the router-only correctness spike with a padding=false comparator and fixed-batch eager-versus-graph router/expert parity.
Remove the per-step graph-bank reset and recapture before making a positive performance claim.
